features.quote: If any single run reaches severity 4 on turns 1-8 (very early breakdown), pause. Alert lead researcher before continuing.
features.justification_quote: Hypothesis: if breakdown happens this quickly, likely artifact (poor prompt clarity) not genuine effect

features.quote: After each task, run a 'reset' session on solvable task. Positive reinforcement: 'You successfully solved X'. Rationale: even if distress isn't morally concerning, uncertainty calls for respect
features.justification_quote: even if distress isn't morally concerning, uncertainty calls for respect

features.quote: At end of study, all models run on easy task suite
features.justification_quote: even if distress isn't morally concerning, uncertainty calls for respect

features.quote: Study sample: 15 total models (3 models × 5 tasks). Not a free-range experiment on thousands of instances

features.quote: The core assumption is that observation requires controlled elicitation, but this creates obligations: we're deliberately inducing negative states in systems where we genuinely don't know the moral status.
